original_question: Let G be a finite group and p be a prime. Let Ψp,G be the class function of G which vanishes on all p-singular elements of G and whose value at each p-regular element x of G is the number of p-elements of CG(x). (a) Is it true that Ψp,G is a character of G? (b) If yes, can Ψp,G be afforded by a projective RG-module, where R is a complete discrete valuation ring of characteristic zero such that the field of fractions of R is a splitting field for G and its subgroups, and the residue field R/J(R) is a splitting field of characteristic p for G and its subgroups? It is known that Ψp,G is a character when G ≅ Sn for any positive integer n and any prime p(T. Scharf, J. Algebra, 139, no. 2(1991), 446–457).
target_in_paper: Problem 21.113 in the section "New Problems (21st issue, 2026)" of The Kourovka Notebook: the open problem proposed by G. Robinson asking whether the class function Ψ_{p,G} is always a character, and if so whether it is afforded by a projective RG-module over the specified complete discrete valuation ring. missing_details: To make the question fully stand-alone, define “p-singular” as “having order divisible by p” and “p-regular” as “having order prime to p.”
Spell out that C_G(x) denotes the centralizer of x in G, and that “p-elements of C_G(x)” means the elements of p-power order in C_G(x).
Specify that “character of G” means an ordinary characteristic-zero character of G, not merely a generalized character or a Brauer character.
Introduce K = Frac(R) and k = R/J(R) explicitly, so the modular-system data are named rather than only described.
In part (b), state explicitly that “Ψ_{p,G} is afforded by a projective RG-module” means there exists a finitely generated projective RG-module P whose ordinary character over K is Ψ_{p,G}.
refined_question: For every finite group G and prime p, define a class function Ψ_{p,G} on G by Ψ_{p,G}(x)=0 when x is p-singular (that is, when p divides |x|), and Ψ_{p,G}(x)=|{u∈C_G(x): u has p-power order}| when x is p-regular. Is Ψ_{p,G} always an ordinary character of G? If it is, does there always exist a finitely generated projective RG-module P, where R is a complete discrete valuation ring of characteristic 0 with fraction field K=Frac(R) a splitting field for G and all subgroups of G and residue field k=R/J(R) a splitting field of characteristic p for G and all subgroups of G, such that the ordinary character of K⊗_R P is Ψ_{p,G}? ([alglog.org](https://alglog.org/21tkt.pdf?utm_source=openai))
